description: Perform a bulk action on multiple posts. Supports deleting, retrying, or rescheduling multiple posts at once. Use this when the user wants to delete, retry, or reschedule many posts in a single request.

postIds.description: Array of post IDs to perform the action on.

scheduledAt.description: New ISO 8601 datetime. Required when action is "reschedule".

name: bulk_posts
title: Bulk post actions
